game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before smoke serpents spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Build a flowchart that reads a and b, adds them, and displays their sum. Test dataset 5: {'a': 5, 'b': 7}; {'a': 0, 'b': 10}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Vent Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the ash barrier using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 14.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the ash barrier is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Vent Garden Trial
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
